page.layout: One block of running text, single column, with a printed page number at the top right and a running head at the top centre. No marginal notes. A chapter heading stands mid-page, followed by one paragraph. A catchword sits at the bottom right and a gathering mark at the bottom left.

main_text.p: nis[?], atq; aliis mortium generibus peremerat. Illud tamen Satanæ organum, iactitant Papico[?] æ, multa tua post mortem clarere miraculis: postq; iam facere dos quidam in Saxonia moriens, Sigeberto teste, in inferno illum cruciari vidisset. Referunt Antoninus ac Vincentius, Hildebrandum ipsum in ultimo vitæ suæ articulo ad se vocasse Cardinalem quendam, ac esse professum, se graviter offendisse, quod suadente diabolo, simultates, inimicitias, odia et bella inter multos excitaverit, iussu[?] q; illum adire Imperatorem Henricum, et ab eo admissorum fa-cinorum veniam petere. Contra hunc Hildebrandum scripserunt Hugo Candidus cardinalis Præ-positus, Vualramus episcopus Niemburgensis, Ve-ricus Vercellensis episcopus, Rolandus Parmensis sacerdos, Sigebertus Gemblacensis, atq; alij multi. Et Benno 13 Cardinales enumerat, qui illum acriter impugnabant.
main_text.head: 99. VICTOR tertius.
main_text.p: Victor tertius, natione Italus, Desiderius antea vocatus, abbas Casinensis, et Romanæ curiæ Cardinalis, Papatum iniit, non Cardinalium aut Romani populi suffragijs electus, sed a Matilda meretrice ac suæ factionis Normannis intrusus. Qui assumpto mox papatu, Gregorij successor constitutus, Gregorij ipsius partes, à dicta Matilda

page.notes: Top-right "209" is the page number; running head reads "ACTIS LIBER V." with the "L" of LIBER partly damaged. The first line is damaged and its opening word is uncertain. "Papico e" is doubtful. "iussu" is partly illegible. "Benno 13" is printed as Arabic numerals. The heading "99. VICTOR tertius." is treated as a level-2 heading. The bottom mark "Q" below the text is read as a gathering signature, which is uncertain. Several words are broken by the scan and may be misread.
